definitions.gloss: prolonged rain; long spell of rain
definitions.explanation: Rain that continues for many days without stopping. Often associated with the rainy season (梅雨) in Japan.

examples.japanese: {長雨|ながあめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{長雨|ながあめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かない→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧。
examples.english: Because of the long rain, the laundry won't dry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長雨|ながあめ}で、{農作物|のうさくもつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: This year's rainy season brought prolonged rain, causing significant damage to crops.

notes:
Compound of {長|なが} (long) + ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ (rain). Refers to continuous rainfall lasting several days or more, not just a single long rainstorm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長雨|ながあめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (the long rain continues)
- {長雨|ながあめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧ (the effects of prolonged rain)
- {長雨|ながあめ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (damage from prolonged rain)

USAGE:
Often used in weather reports and news about the ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season, June–July). Can also describe any extended period of rain outside the rainy season, such as ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長雨|ながあめ} (autumn long rains).
